# invented example
tables:
  entries | entry-table.tsv | tsv | entry
  origins | origin-table.csv | csv | origin
references:
  entries | cites | origins | origin | list ,
required:
  entries | grade
values:
  entries | grade | A | B | C | D
dates:
  entries | recorded
corrections:
  entries | corrects | recorded
earlier:
  entries | entry-table-before.tsv
